mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 1.41% represents a historically low level that reduces discount rates for equity valuations and stimulates economic activity, producing positive 20-day forward returns for the S&P 500 without requiring additional threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward return is negative in the next trading period.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative 5-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through joint economic effects.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 100k AND UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts > 1200k units and retail sales > $500 billion), strong demand signals support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive 60-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1200 AND RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: Core CPI exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 indicates manufacturing sector contraction and economic slowdown, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic growth, boosting corporate profits and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), Federal Reserve policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and dampen economic activity, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
